faq.q: How do I compare two lists?
faq.a: Paste the first list into List A and the second into List B, one item per line. DiffDuo instantly shows the items only in List A, only in List B, in both lists, and the duplicates in each.

faq.q: How do I find duplicates between two lists?
faq.a: The items that appear in both lists are shown under In both lists. You can copy them with one click or download them as a .txt file.

faq.q: How do I remove duplicates from a list?
faq.a: Paste the list into List A and leave List B empty. All unique items shows every item exactly once, and Duplicates in List A shows the items that were repeated.

faq.q: Can I compare two columns from Excel?
faq.a: Yes. Copy a column from Excel or Google Sheets and paste it into List A, then paste the other column into List B. Each cell becomes one item.

faq.q: Can I use commas or semicolons instead of new lines?
faq.a: Yes. Choose comma, semicolon or tab under Split by. New lines always separate items too.
